Definition: a Ludite or inhabitants of Lud (only in plural)
BiblicalUsage: The Ludites were the people of Lud, named among the sons of Mizraim in the table of nations, and Jeremiah calls them to come forth with shield and bow among the mighty men of Egypt's army. They are a people known to Scripture mainly as warriors for hire, standing with the powers of their day.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Ludites warn us that skill with a bow is no substitute for standing with God. I hold that nations are known by whom they serve, and those who sell their strength to the highest bidder end up on the losing side.
